Study notes

Renders here are real: the deployed BLOCKS_SINGLE_V1 renderer on Ethereum Sepolia draws each card inside a 500,000,000-gas static call, from the same 3,520-byte input mint() would store. The lab block is simulated, as in the V3 diversity audit: block 13,000,000 with a fixed timestamp, gas limit, base fee, beneficiary and chain ID. Only prevrandao changes, and it is the seed shown on each card.

Scene choice is computed in your browser with an exact port of SingleBlockData and Epoch.scene, verified byte-for-byte against the deployed contracts. Forced scene and rare studies search for seeds of that scene; they do not represent mint probabilities. V2 and V3 are prepared, undeployed revisions; their cards are first-frame posters from measured previews.
